title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
abstract: arXiv:2611.30494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. translated_title: 重新审视大语言模型作为上下文工程师
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型被应用于越来越多的新任务，上下文工程成为一种基础方法，通过构建指令提示或元数据来高效引导大语言模型，而无需大量训练。越来越多的LLM上下文工程（LCE）方法通过将LLM本身作为工程师来自动化这一任务，即让LLM从离线试验中提取可泛化的指令或经验作为上下文。尽管这些方法类似于人类从经验中学习的方式，但目前仍不清楚LLM在何时以及如何从数据中构建出有效的上下文。为了回答这一问题，我们首先建立了一个由具有不同推理模式的数据集组成的基准测试。我们比较了不同LLM家族（8B规模）下的不同LCE方法，结果表明没有任何一种方法能在所有任务中胜出，即使与思维链这样的简单基线相比也是如此。即使通过更多参数或生成……来扩展模型能力时（摘要此处被截断），……
tldr: 该研究建立了包含不同推理模式的数据集基准，系统评估了多种LLM上下文工程方法，发现没有单一方法能在所有任务中胜出，甚至可能不敌思维链等简单基线。
en_tdlr: This study establishes a benchmark of datasets with diverse reasoning patterns to systematically evaluate LLM context engineering methods, finding that no single method wins across all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought.
